subject.title: Pace percentage metric missing from menu bar

question: Should CodexBar restore a pace-percentage metric as a supported menu-bar display option alongside the current "Runs out" metric?
rationale: The report requests a preference/display capability rather than identifying a defined broken contract, and no source-level evidence was available to determine whether the old metric can be restored without a new product surface.

options.title: Restore pace percentage
options.body: Add the prior pace-percent presentation as an optional metric while retaining the existing "Runs out" metric.

options.title: Keep current metrics
options.body: Retain the redesigned metric set and close the request only after explaining why pace percentage is no longer supported.

recommendation.title: Restore pace percentage
recommendation.body: Add the prior pace-percent presentation as an optional metric while retaining the existing "Runs out" metric.

likelyOwner.reason: Code and history inspection was unavailable, so an evidence-backed owner cannot be selected.
